text: The last freight entry in the station waiting room was never canceled. Its destination still reads Mars. A pump station is marked on the back of the repair map.
Following the workshop's trial-build notes, they connected the filter pipes. The pump station became the team's water stop, and the settlement can set up supply outposts along the pipeline.
Two rounds of ammunition spent. The beetle ahead retreated, but the gunfire drew new followers.
The team used two steps' worth of supplies to go around, leaving no gunfire behind.
The instrument was dismantled for scrap. The paper records were scattered by damp and can no longer be organized.
The team left behind {变量1} rations. The old surveyor marked the locations of the pump station and the beetle hollow.
They agreed to move in once the settlement had three beds available.
The old surveyor and his two apprentices moved into the settlement. He remembers the old city's road numbers.
Old Surveyor Lin Heng stepped down from daily duty. The Survey Office took over the records.
Residents held an election as agreed every ten years. The incumbent was reelected, retaining their duties and the year they took office.
First Artisan A-Cen stepped down from daily duty. The workshop rotation took over the records.
